citations.claim: Initial total energy establishes baseline ~303.6 J
Energy still near baseline just before impact resolution
First violating step: energy jumps to ~411.8 J exceeding allowed 338.96 J

explanation: A 1kg body falls onto a 0.2kg body resting near the floor, both e=1. Sequential impulse plus positional correction resolving body-body and body-floor contacts within one coarse step injects ~106 J in one step (305->411 J), far beyond the 10%+5J tolerance, with zero controller work. Classic stacked-contact energy creation.
vision_note: The larger upper circle falls toward the much smaller lower circle, then the small circle suddenly shoots downward covering a large gap in one step. The upper circle stays almost stationary in mid-air while the lower circle is ejected toward the bottom edge by step 65.
